name: OK Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Jiujiang, China, OK Science and Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2011, specializes in developing and manufacturing industrial machinery. The company engineers and produces a full range of equipment for the tissue paper industry, encompassing core paper production as well as converting and packaging lines for various finished goods such as facial tissues, napkins, toilet paper, kitchen towels, and pocket tissues. Additionally, their product portfolio includes specialized machines for the fabrication of disposable surgical masks and KN95 masks.
